data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 and SRC_003 are compatible with each other as independent instances of the same inclusion-exclusion schema applied to the digit-repetition complement, differing only in how the pair-overlaps are enumerated (SRC_001 via ordered patterns AAB/ABA/BAA + AAA correction; SRC_003 via event-set notation |A_h=t|, |A_t=u|, |A_h=u| + triple intersection). Both inherit the same PIE structure. This is refuted if the two enumeration schemes assign different sizes to any of the three pairwise intersections or the triple intersection, or if the ordered-pattern sum in SRC_001 (81 + 81 + 72) corresponds to a different partition of the 252 tuples than the event-sets in SRC_003 (90 + 90 + 90).
